items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: Both defects root-caused and fixed; scope mark relocated to setup_iterate_worktree.py, implementation span backstopped by a new hook. No extra features beyond the spec (reporting logic untouched as required).

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: _mark_scope_started catches (OSError, ValueError) and logs to stderr rather than failing the run; mark_implementation_span.py wraps main() in a broad except and always exits 0, matching iterate_timing.py's existing best-effort/never-block contract.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: No user input, no SQL/HTML, no secrets. The Bash-command string match is a substring check on the local session's own tool_input, not externally-controlled input, and only triggers additive JSONL appends.

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: 21 new tests across two files assert on sidecar contents (outcomes), not internals; each covers a happy path and at least one negative/edge case (ignored write, no-prior-start, unrelated command, outside-active-iterate, malformed stdin).

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: No DB/N+1 concerns; the new hook does one sidecar read (read_raw_events) and at most one lock-guarded append per Write/Edit/Bash call, matching the existing mark_plugin_edit.py/check_file_size.py hooks' per-call cost.

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: New files follow existing shared/scripts/hooks and shared/tests conventions. setup_iterate_worktree.py was trimmed from 314 back to 299 lines after crossing 300 (bloat gate crossing), staying under the 300-line source cap.

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: Both changed serialized formats (phase_timings.jsonl, iterate_timings.jsonl) have producer+consumer identified in the spec's Affected Boundaries table, each with a real round-trip test (write via the real writer, read back via the real reader) against real git worktree state, not mocks. touches_io_boundary fired on hooks.json; the mandatory round-trip is covered by test_phase_plugin_hooks_consistency.py + test_hook_output_schema_compliance.py.

items.name: Test Hygiene Probe
items.note: uv run shared/scripts/tools/scan_test_hygiene.py --diff reported 'no findings' against the full changed-file diff.
